command.name: security key-manager external barbican update-credentials
command.description: This command provides a way to update the authentication credentials that are used for a Barbican configuration. The credentials are initially set by running the security key-manager external barbican create-config command.

parameter.name: vserver
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the Vserver for which the Keystone application credentials are to be updated.

parameter.name: config-name
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the configuration name for which the Keystone application credentials are to be updated.

parameter.name: application-cred-id
parameter.description: Use this parameter to specify the new Keystone application credentials ID.

example.p: The following example shows updating the Keystone application credentials for the configuration on data Vserver v1.
example.screen:
cluster-1::> security key-manager external barbican update-credentials -vserver v1 -config-name config1 -application-cred-id app_cred_id
Enter the new Barbican Key Management Service application credentials secret:
